mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates for equity valuation in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 10.0%) indicates economic distress and reduced corporate earnings potential, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0, or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 98 and employment (PAYEMS) is above 130000, it indicates robust economic expansion supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 98 and PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor in tightening cycles is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low housing starts rate (HOUST) indicates weak residential construction and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 600, or Rank IC for HOUST as predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI (CPIAUCSL > 215.7) indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.7, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When business spending (RSAFS) is above 340000 and housing starts (HOUST) is below 600, it indicates a strong business sector and weak housing market supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 340000 and HOUST < 600, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 98), the economy near full capacity supports positive S&P 500 forward returns due to strong corporate earnings and investor confidence over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 98, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
